title: Alien Dictionary
constraints: words[i] consists of lowercase English letters
inputFormat: Implement alienDictionary(words), where words is an array of strings in the proposed alien lexicographic order.
outputFormat: A string containing each observed letter exactly once in a valid order, or "" if no order exists. Any valid order is accepted.

visuals.title: Letter order in example 1
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 480 85" role="img" aria-label="w precedes e, e precedes r, r precedes t, and t precedes f" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:480px;color:var(--color-text)"><circle cx="40" cy="42" r="20" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="var(--color-border)"/><text x="40" y="48" fill="currentColor" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="20">w</text><path d="M65 42h40m-6-5 6 5-6 5" stroke="currentColor" fill="none"/><circle cx="130" cy="42" r="20" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="var(--color-border)"/><text x="130" y="48" fill="currentColor" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="20">e</text><path d="M155 42h40m-6-5 6 5-6 5" stroke="currentColor" fill="none"/><circle cx="220" cy="42" r="20" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="var(--color-border)"/><text x="220" y="48" fill="currentColor" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="20">r</text><path d="M245 42h40m-6-5 6 5-6 5" stroke="currentColor" fill="none"/><circle cx="310" cy="42" r="20" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="var(--color-border)"/><text x="310" y="48" fill="currentColor" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="20">t</text><path d="M335 42h40m-6-5 6 5-6 5" stroke="currentColor" fill="none"/><circle cx="400" cy="42" r="20" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="var(--color-border)"/><text x="400" y="48" fill="currentColor" text-anchor="middle" font-family="monospace" font-size="20">f</text></svg>
visuals.caption: Adjacent word comparisons give t → f, w → e, r → t, and e → r. Together they require the order wertf.
